args.sql:
SELECT 
    t.transreg,
    t.transtime,
    sf.infoleaksc,
    (sf.optvolrt * sf.infoleaksc) AS sdlr_score
FROM 
    transactionrecord AS t
JOIN 
    sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
        ON t.transreg = sf.transref
WHERE 
    sf.infoleaksc > 0
ORDER BY 
    sdlr_score DESC;
